questions.question: Who became the first player in Major League Soccer history to win the Golden Boot award in back-to-back years?
questions.explanation: Inter Miami star Lionel Messi claimed the Golden Boot again after scoring 26 goals during the 2026 MLS season.
questions.context: 2026 Major League Soccer season: In association football, Inter Miami player Lionel Messi is awarded the 2026 Golden Boot Award after scoring 26 goals in one season, becoming the first player in league history to win the award in consecutive years.

questions.question: Regulators in South Korea recently penalised two major tech firms for anti-competitive behaviour in which sector?
questions.explanation: The South Korean Fair Trade Commission fined platforms Woowa Brothers and Coupang for unfair practices regarding restaurant pricing terms.
questions.context: The South Korean Fair Trade Commission issues fines of ₩331.1 billion (US$247 million) for Woowa Brothers and ₩300.8 billion ($222 million) for Coupang, finding that their food-delivery platforms restricted competition by requiring restaurants to match rival platforms' terms.

questions.question: Leaders from Cyprus and Northern Cyprus recently agreed to take what step to promote peace?
questions.explanation: The two leaders agreed to create two new crossing points across the United Nations Buffer Zone.
questions.context: Cyprus problem: Cypriot president Nikos Christodoulides and Northern Cypriot president Tufan Erhürman agree to establish two additional crossings across the United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus and hold further peace negotiations.
